options: Heat shimmers rise from the cracked earth.
The wind carries dust and the smell of rust.
Nothing but desolation stretches to the horizon.
Rusted structures dot the barren landscape.

text_options: Movement in the heat haze — something approaches.
A dust cloud rises in the distance.
The wasteland holds secrets for those who look.
Raiders emerge from behind rusted wreckage!
Scavengers spot you and move to intercept!
Wasteland bandits descend from the ridgeline!
You scavenge useful parts from the wreckage.
Among the ruins, you find salvageable materials.
The wasteland yields its treasures to the persistent.
A dust storm kicks up!
Sandstorm! Visibility drops to nothing.
Scorching winds blast across the plains.
The wasteland is quiet. Too quiet.
Nothing but the wind and dust.
The silence is oppressive, but at least it's safe.
A lone trader crosses the wasteland.
A wanderer appears, looking for company.
A scavenger waves from the roadside.

options: The desert cools rapidly. Frost forms on metal.
Stars blaze overhead in the unpolluted sky. The cold bites.
Night turns the wasteland into a frozen expanse.
Without the sun's heat, the wasteland becomes dangerously cold.

text_options: The freezing cold saps your strength.
Hypothermia threatens in the desert night.
Night raiders attack under cover of darkness!
Nocturnal predators hunt in the cold!
Bandits strike while you shelter from the cold!
A bitter but uneventful night passes.
You huddle against the cold. Dawn can't come soon enough.
The sun rises, bringing warmth back to the wasteland.
Dawn paints the ruins in golden light. A new day.
Heat returns with the morning sun.
